crossRefs.note: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.
“Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.
I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.
My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
Yahweh God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?
Yahweh, how long will I cry, and you will not hear? I cry out to you “Violence!” and will you not save?
About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why…

translations.web: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.
translations.bsb: Even when I cry out and plead for help, He shuts out my prayer.
translations.kjv: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.
translations.asv: Yea, when I cry, and call for help, he shutteth out my prayer.
